mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing expected equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing expected corporate profits and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 200K indicates strengthening labor demand, boosting expected profits and discount rate compression, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 indicates weakening supply capacity, reducing expected growth and discount rate compression, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 signals supply expansion, boosting expected growth and discount rate compression, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in home sales (HOUST) below 500K indicates weakening demand, reducing expected growth and discount rate compression, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in home sales (HOUST) above 600K signals strong demand, boosting expected growth and discount rate compression, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
